narrative.overview: The Manzoma visual system is built for the decisive, fast-paced merchant who demands uncompromising speed, airtight financial control, and modern elegance. It moves away from sterile, drab enterprise accounting tables and outdated blue-gray legacy software toward an energetic, radiant, and reassuring experience. The system blends deep, commanding navy depths (#0D1B4A) with electric brand blues (#3B5BFF), crisp white functional cards, and high-conversion emerald CTA accents (#10B981) that signify profitability and swift action.
keyCharacteristics: Decisive Contrast: Deep navy headers anchor attention; high-contrast typography ensures readability in bright retail sunlight.
Luminous Precision: Ambient radial cyan and violet glows paired with subtle technical grid patterns reflect advanced AI and real-time sync.
Tactile Confidence: High-elevation hover lifts, crisp borders, and purposeful emerald micro-interactions make every action feel responsive and confirmed.
RTL-Native Craft: Layouts, icons, indicators, and animations flow seamlessly from right to left with typographic harmony in both Arabic (Cairo) and Latin (Inter) scripts.

rules.name: The Single CTA Voice Rule
rules.body: Emerald (#10B981) is reserved exclusively for the single highest-value action on any viewport. Secondary actions must step down to neutral slate or outlined glass.

rules.name: The Ambient Glow Rule
rules.body: Luminous radial glows (blur(150px)) and cyan text shimmers are used as atmospheric backdrops only; they never sit behind low-contrast body text.

rules.name: The Tabular Metric Rule
rules.body: All financial amounts, quantity counts, and barcode sequences must render with tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) so decimal points align vertically across invoices and data tables.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Interactive cards and buttons must sit calm at rest with subtle 1px border containment. Shadows bloom only upon mouse hover or focus-visible state to signal readiness.

dos: Do use standard SVG icons (Lucide React) with a consistent 20px / 24px stroke across all cards and buttons.
Do maintain RTL-first alignment for all Arabic content, placing chevron indicators on the left (ChevronLeft) to reflect forward progression.
Do enforce tabular numbers (tabular-nums) on all invoice prices, quantities, and barcode displays.
Do test light mode and dark mode side-by-side to guarantee WCAG AA contrast (>= 4.5:1).
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion by disabling float keyframes and large scale animations for sensitive users.
donts: Don't use emojis as interface icons (e.g. 🚀, 💰, 📦). Always use dedicated Lucide SVG icons.
Don't create pure black backgrounds (#000000). Use rich deep navy tones (#0A192F and #112240) to preserve depth and reduce glare.
Don't place green CTA colors on secondary or cancel actions. Green is exclusively for positive conversion.
Don't allow layout shifts on hover. Never scale card dimensions; only transform translateY or animate shadows and borders.
Don't hide critical business proof (offline status, encryption, live sync) behind ambiguous generic marketing slogans.
